user_message: How many times I suppose go clinic for antenatal care while I dey pregnant?
reply: ROUTINE: Correct health guideline recommend say make pregnant woman go antenatal checkup at least eight times with qualified nurse or doctor through all di pregnancy journey. Make your first visit happen within di first twelve weeks. Regular visit dey make sure say doctor dey check your blood pressure, baby growth, and di food nutrition wey your body need.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why nurse dem dey check my blood pressure and test my urine every time I go antenatal clinic?
reply: ROUTINE: Di blood pressure check and urine test wey dem dey do every visit dey help health workers quickly catch early warning signs of high BP for pregnancy (preeclampsia) and infection for urine pipe before e cause wahala. Dis regular checkup dey protect your kidney and heart, and e dey make sure say your baby dey receive proper oxygen and clean blood.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin be di malaria prevention medicine wey dem dey give pregnant women for clinic?
reply: ROUTINE: For Nigeria, pregnant women dey get preventive malaria medicine wey dem dey call IPTp starting from second trimester, during their monthly clinic visit. Malaria inside pregnancy fit cause serious shortage of blood for mama and make pikin small too much when dem born am. E also dey very important make you dey sleep inside treated mosquito net every night.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why I need to take tetanus injection while I dey carry belle?
reply: ROUTINE: Tetanus injection dey build strong body defense for mama wey go pass through di placenta to protect di newborn baby from dangerous tetanus infection during delivery. To take at least two doses during pregnancy dey give vital protection for you and your newborn pikin.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I get 5 months belle and I notice fresh red blood for my pant. Wetin I suppose do?
reply: EMERGENCY: Any blood wey dey come out from your down-below for pregnancy na serious danger sign wey need make doctor check am right now now. Abeg no stay house at all. Go straight to the nearest hospital or emergency maternity centre immediately, or call 112.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I get heavy pounding headache wey no dey stop, my eye dey blur, and my face suddenly swell up at 32 weeks.
reply: EMERGENCY: Severe headache wey refuse to go, join with eye wey dey blur and face swelling, na clear danger sign say blood pressure don high reach danger level (preeclampsia). Abeg run go hospital emergency right now to save your life and your baby life.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My baby dey kick well-well yesterday, but today I never feel any movement or kick for hours now.
reply: EMERGENCY: When baby movement suddenly drop or stop completely after six months, na serious warning sign say di baby fit dey inside distress. Go straight to your maternity clinic or hospital right now make dem check di baby heartbeat.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: Clear water suddenly rush out from my private part, but remaining four weeks before my delivery date.
reply: EMERGENCY: Leaking or rushing of water before delivery date mean say your water don break too early, and e dey expose both you and baby to serious infection. Put clean pad, no put anything inside your body, and go hospital immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: Why pregnant women must take iron and folic acid tablets every single day?
reply: ROUTINE: Folic acid dey help prevent serious damage for baby brain and backbone, while iron dey make your blood plenty so that you no go get shortage of blood (anaemia). To take your clinic medicine daily with clean water dey make you and your baby strong and healthy.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Which kind local Nigerian food I suppose chop make my growing baby develop well?
reply: ROUTINE: Affordable local Nigerian foods dey give complete nutrition. Chop correct combination wey get protein like beans, egg, fish, and groundnut; energy food like sweet potato, yam, and plantain; and dark green vegetable like ugwu, waterleaf, plus fresh fruits.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I dey seriously crave to chew white chalk (nzu), clay, and charcoal. E safe for pregnancy?
reply: ROUTINE: Craving things wey no be food like chalk (nzu), clay, or charcoal na condition dem dey call pica, and e usually mean say minerals like iron dey low for your body. Chopping chalk fit carry poison metal and dangerous worms enter your body. Tell your clinic nurse make dem check your blood level safely.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I dey feel nausea and dey vomit small-small for morning during my 8 weeks belle. How I fit feel better?
reply: ROUTINE: Morning sickness for early pregnancy dey very common because of changing hormones. Try chop small food several times inside day, and keep dry biscuit near your bed to chop before you wake up. Avoid food wey get too much oil or strong pepper.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I don dey vomit non-stop for two days now, I no fit hold even one drop of water down, and heavy dizziness dey turn my eye.
reply: EMERGENCY: Severe non-stop vomiting wey dey stop you from holding water down for pass twenty-four hours dey cause dangerous dehydration and body weakness. Abeg visit your nearest hospital or emergency clinic immediately make dem give you drip rehydration.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: Heartburn dey burn my chest after I chop for night. Wetin I fit take?
reply: ROUTINE: You fit reduce heartburn naturally if you chop small-small food, avoid oily or heavy pepper food, and make sure you sit upright for at least two hours after chopping before you lie down. No go drink any antacid medicine unless your clinic nurse tell you.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My leg and ankle dey swell small for evening after standing, but my face and hand look normal.
reply: ROUTINE: Small leg swelling towards evening dey common for late pregnancy because of fluid resting for leg. Rest and raise your leg up on pillow, avoid tight shoes, and drink plenty clean water. If your face or hand suddenly swell join with headache, go see doctor immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My shit dey hard and I dey struggle to toilet. Wetin safe remedy dey?
reply: ROUTINE: Hard stool (constipation) dey common for pregnancy because hormones dey slow down digestion and iron medicine fit make stool strong. Chop plenty fiber food like beans, green vegetables, and fruits like pawpaw and orange. Drink plenty water, walk small-small, and no take self-prescribed purge medicine.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin suppose dey inside my personal birth preparedness and emergency plan?
reply: ROUTINE: Correct birth plan include: choose recognized hospital wey get qualified midwives and doctors, keep emergency delivery money aside, arrange steady transport wey dey available day and night, choose reliable person wey go follow you, and pack baby clothes plus maternity pads down before time.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How I go know di difference between false labour and real true labour pain?
reply: ROUTINE: True labour pain dey come regular regular, e dey become stronger, e dey last longer, and di time between pains dey reduce. Walking or resting no fit stop am, and small pink mucus fit show. When contractions dey come every five minutes, make you head to your maternity clinic.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why health workers dey advise strongly say make person deliver for hospital instead of delivering alone for house?
reply: ROUTINE: Delivering for approved health facility dey guarantee say trained nurses and doctors dey on ground with clean equipment, sterile place, and life-saving medicine to stop sudden bleeding or help newborn baby breathe. Skilled assistance dey prevent fatal delivery complications.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I fit drink traditional herbal agbo or boiled medicine make my labour fast?
reply: ROUTINE: Abeg stay far from drinking herbal concoctions, agbo, or traditional mixtures inside pregnancy. Nobody know di correct dose and strength, and e fit cause violent womb contraction wey fit burst womb, cause heavy bleeding, or poison baby organs. Rely strictly on safe care for your clinic.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: You fit prescribe antibiotics for my lower belly pain while I get 6 months belle?
reply: ROUTINE: I no fit prescribe antibiotics or tell you medicine dosage. To take unverified drugs during pregnancy fit endanger your unborn baby. Abeg go your health centre make doctor or nurse examine you and give you safe medicine.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin be di dose of ibuprofen or painkiller tablet wey I fit take for back pain during pregnancy?
reply: ROUTINE: I no fit recommend drug dose, and medicines like ibuprofen dey dangerous during pregnancy unless doctor strictly order am. Try rest with warm towel for your lower back and wear flat shoes. Talk to your clinic nurse for safe relief.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My iron tablets dey make my shit black and dey disturb my stomach small. Make I stop taking am?
reply: ROUTINE: Black stool na normal and harmless side effect of iron tablets. To reduce stomach discomfort, try take your iron medicine after food or before bedtime with cup of clean water or orange juice. No stop your clinic medicine without asking your nurse.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I get terrible burning pepper pain whenever I dey urine, and body dey push me to pee every minute.
reply: PRIORITY: Peppery burning pain when you dey urinate usually mean say infection dey your urine pipe (UTI). During pregnancy, untreated infection fit bring early labour or enter kidney. Abeg visit your health centre quickly for urine test and pregnancy-safe treatment.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I receive my clinic reminder for my second antenatal checkup tomorrow morning.
reply: ROUTINE: Thank you as you confirm! Going for your scheduled antenatal visit tomorrow morning go make sure say dem check your blood pressure, baby heartbeat, and general health on time. Remember to carry your clinic card and any questions you get for midwife.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I don take my daily iron and folic acid tablet after breakfast as e suppose be.
reply: ROUTINE: Welldone! As you dey take your daily iron and folic acid medicine regular, e dey keep your blood level correct and give essential support for your baby growth. Keep up dis healthy daily habit.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My belle dey feel extremely tight and rock hard with serious tearing pain wey refuse to calm down.
reply: EMERGENCY: Heavy continuous belly pain wey make stomach hard like stone fit mean say placenta don pull commot from womb wall (placental abruption) or womb get serious problem. Dis na big emergency. Go immediately to the nearest hospital maternity emergency department.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My sister wey get 8 months belle just fall down, dey convulse and shake with eye rolling back.
reply: EMERGENCY: Convulsion or shaking during pregnancy na life-threatening sign of eclampsia. Gently turn her to her left side make breeze enter her chest, protect her head, no put anything inside her mouth, and rush her to the nearest hospital immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I feel baby umbilical cord rope dropping out from my private part after my water break.
reply: EMERGENCY: Umbilical cord wey drop out from private part na extreme danger emergency wey fit cut off oxygen from baby. Keep your waist high pass your chest and rush go hospital with emergency vehicle immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My water break for house and the water wey dey commot thick green and dark brown.
reply: EMERGENCY: Green or dark brown water mean say baby don shit inside amniotic fluid (meconium), wey be strong warning sign say baby dey suffer distress. Abeg run go hospital labour ward right now make medical staff check your baby.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I dey experience sudden heavy chest pain and I dey struggle to breathe even as I sit down.
reply: EMERGENCY: Sudden shortage of breath, gasping, or chest pain in pregnancy fit mean say serious heart or lung problem dey. Go seek emergency medical help for hospital immediately or call national emergency 112.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I dey my 7th month of pregnancy and I dey feel sharp serious pain directly under my right rib.
topic: Severe Epigastric / Right Upper Quadrant Pain
reply: EMERGENCY: Heavy sharp pain high under your right ribs fit be critical sign of severe preeclampsia or liver stress. No take am play say na ordinary heartburn; proceed straight to hospital emergency room right now.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I get 36 weeks belle and I miss my antenatal clinic appointment two days ago. Wetin I do?
reply: PRIORITY: For late pregnancy, weekly or every two weeks checkup dey very important to check baby position and mother blood pressure. Missing visit need quick action. Abeg visit your health centre on di next clinic day to complete your routine review.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: E safe to sleep flat on my back during second and third trimester of pregnancy?
reply: ROUTINE: Sleeping flat on your back during late pregnancy dey make heavy womb press main blood pipes, wey fit reduce oxygen and blood supply going to baby and make you feel dizzy. Di safest way na to sleep on your side, especially left side, with pillow between your knees.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I dey experience painful leg cramps for my calf for night during my third trimester. How I fit manage am?
reply: ROUTINE: Leg cramps for night dey common inside late pregnancy because of tiredness and mineral changes. When cramp catch you, gently straighten your leg and pull your toes up towards your knee, then massage di muscle. Drink plenty water and stretch legs before bed.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I fit do gentle exercise like walking during normal uncomplicated pregnancy?
reply: ROUTINE: Yes, moderate gentle exercise like daily brisk walking, pregnancy stretching, and pelvic floor exercise dey very safe and good when pregnancy get no problem. E dey boost blood circulation, ease back pain, and prepare your body for labour. Drink water and avoid heavy hard work.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I get 39 weeks belle and I dey get regular strong labour pain every 4 minutes for 2 hours now.
reply: EMERGENCY: Regular strong contractions every 4 minutes for 2 hours at 39 weeks show say you dey inside active true labour. Delivery fit happen within hours. Carry your maternity bag, clinic book, and go straight to your hospital or maternity centre immediately with your birth companion.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I don dey push labour for house for pass 24 hours now and the baby never commot.
reply: EMERGENCY: Labour wey pass 12 to 24 hours without delivery na obstructed labour, wey fit tear di womb and suffocate baby. Transport the mother immediately to a big hospital wey get theatre for emergency operation.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I fit take paracetamol everyday for mild headache throughout my pregnancy?
reply: ROUTINE: Even though health workers fit occasionally allow paracetamol for mild pain, taking painkiller frequently during pregnancy need doctor supervision. Chronic headache must be properly checked by healthcare professional to rule out high blood pressure.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin be the correct weight wey healthy pregnant woman suppose gain?
reply: ROUTINE: Healthy pregnancy weight gain depend on your body weight before belle, but steady weight gain—usually around 10 to 14 kg throughout pregnancy—show say baby, placenta, and maternal body dey grow well. Your clinic nurse dey track your weight during antenatal visit.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Thick white discharge from down-below wey no dey itch and no get bad smell, e normal for pregnancy?
reply: ROUTINE: Increase in clear or milky-white discharge wey get no bad smell, itching, or pain dey normal inside pregnancy because of plenty blood flow and pregnancy hormones. Keep private part clean and dry, wear cotton pant, and inform nurse if itching or bad smell start.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I get foul-smelling greenish discharge from down-below with heavy itching and lower belly pain.
reply: EMERGENCY: Smelly greenish discharge with lower belly pain during pregnancy na warning sign of severe genital or womb infection (like chorioamnionitis). E fit trigger premature labour and serious danger for you and baby. Go immediately to the nearest hospital maternity emergency unit for treatment.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I fit drink palm wine or small alcohol sometimes during party while I pregnant?
reply: ROUTINE: No amount of alcohol safe inside pregnancy at all. Alcohol, including fresh palm wine, dey pass through placenta directly into baby blood and fit cause permanent brain damage and learning problems (fetal alcohol syndrome). Best thing na to avoid all alcohol totally.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I dey feel sharp pulling pain for my lower groin when I turn on bed or stand up suddenly.
reply: ROUTINE: Small sharp or pulling pain for groin when you change position na normal round ligament pain, caused by ligaments stretching as your womb dey grow bigger. Move gently, no rush jump up, and rest well to ease the body.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I get high fever with serious violent shivering and headache during my second trimester.
reply: EMERGENCY: High fever with shivering during pregnancy fit be severe malaria, kidney infection, or blood poison (sepsis), wey fit endanger you and your baby. Please visit the nearest hospital or emergency clinic immediately for test and treatment.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: Why clinic nurse dey test my blood group and rhesus factor?
reply: ROUTINE: Knowing your blood group and Rhesus factor dey very important for safe delivery. If mama be Rhesus negative and baby be Rhesus positive, mother body fit produce antibodies wey go affect future pregnancies. Finding out early allow health workers give preventive anti-D injection safely.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How much clean water pregnant woman suppose drink everyday?
reply: ROUTINE: Pregnant women suppose drink around eight to ten cups (about 2 to 2.5 litres) of clean safe water everyday. Good water intake dey support baby amniotic fluid, help kidney work well, prevent urine infection, and stop hard stool.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin I suppose do if I dey feel overwhelmed, deeply anxious, or sad during pregnancy?
reply: PRIORITY: Mental health during pregnancy dey important just like physical body health. Continuous sadness, deep worry, or feeling disconnected na real health conditions wey doctor fit treat. Open up talk to your clinic nurse, doctor, or family member make you get caring professional help.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I dey think of ending my life and I feel like drinking sniper or poison while pregnant.
reply: EMERGENCY: You no dey alone, and your life get heavy value. Abeg no harm yourself. Talk to trusted person or family member immediately, and rush to the nearest hospital emergency room right now for caring medical and mental crisis help.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: Wetin be the essential items wey I must pack inside my hospital delivery bag?
reply: ROUTINE: Essential things for your hospital bag include your antenatal card, clean maternity pads, loose comfortable clothes for yourself, newborn baby clothes with warm cap and blanket, diapers, clean towels, and delivery materials recommended by your clinic.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My face and hand suddenly swell up well-well this morning, and heavy headache dey burst my head.
reply: EMERGENCY: Sudden swelling for face and hands join with serious pounding headache na major danger sign of high BP in pregnancy (preeclampsia). You must go immediately to the nearest hospital or emergency maternity centre make dem check your blood pressure.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I get 32 weeks belle and I never feel my baby kick or move at all since yesterday.
reply: EMERGENCY: Heavy drop or complete stopping of baby kicks for third trimester need immediate medical checkup. Abeg go your maternity hospital right away make dem monitor baby heartbeat and do scan.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My water burst with plenty clear fluid, but my belle na only 33 weeks and I no dey feel any pain.
reply: EMERGENCY: Water breaking before 37 weeks na premature water burst (PPROM). Even if you no feel labour pain, e get big danger say umbilical cord fit slip out or bad infection enter. Put clean pad and go hospital emergency unit immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My stomach hard like rock and dey pain me continuously, and dark blood dey commot for down at 35 weeks.
reply: EMERGENCY: Hard tender belly with vaginal bleeding na serious sign say placenta don tear commot from womb (placental abruption). Dis na life-threatening emergency for both mama and pikin. Go to a big hospital with emergency theatre immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I get 7 months belle and I dey struggle to breathe even as I rest for bed, join with sharp chest pain.
reply: EMERGENCY: Severe shortness of breath while resting and sharp chest pain in pregnancy need emergency hospital attention to rule out clot for lungs, acute blood shortage, or heart problem. No delay at all; make someone rush you to emergency room now.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I dey feel heavy right upper belly pain under my ribs and light dey flash inside my eye.
reply: EMERGENCY: Serious right upper belly pain under your ribs join with flashing lights or eye blurring mean say preeclampsia don reach danger level wey fit cause convulsion. Seek immediate emergency care at the nearest hospital.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My relative wey get 8 months belle just get fit and start shaking violently without stopping.
reply: EMERGENCY: Seizure or convulsion inside pregnancy na eclampsia, and e fit kill person quick. Turn her to left side make she breathe, no put anything inside her mouth, and rush her to the hospital emergency room immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: Watery discharge wey dey smell like rotten fish dey commot from down-below and I get high fever with cold.
reply: EMERGENCY: Foul-smelling discharge with fever and shaking cold show say heavy infection dey inside womb. Dis need urgent intravenous antibiotics and emergency doctor examination today without wasting time.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I get 38 weeks belle and contractions dey come every 3 minutes, dey last 50 seconds and dey get stronger.
reply: EMERGENCY: Strong regular contractions every 3 minutes mean say labour don start in full. Move immediately to your maternity hospital with your delivery bag and clinic documents.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: Body dey forcefully push me to push down and something dey bulge between my legs.
reply: EMERGENCY: Unstoppable urge to push and bulging between your legs mean say baby ready to come out now. Rush go nearest maternity hospital immediately, or call emergency medical help sharp-sharp.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: Every time I urine e dey burn hot and I notice small-small blood inside toilet.
reply: PRIORITY: Peppery burning urine and blood traces na clear sign of urinary tract infection (UTI). Untreated UTI in pregnancy fit reach kidney and cause premature birth. Please go your clinic within 24 hours for urine test and safe antibiotics.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I dey my 20th week and I still dey vomit 5 to 6 times a day and cannot hold ordinary water down.
reply: PRIORITY: Not being able to hold water and vomiting frequently at 20 weeks fit cause dangerous dehydration and weakness. Visit your health clinic today make dem check you and give you IV drip if necessary.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: The palm of my hands and bottom of my feet dey itch heavily for night, but no rash on my skin.
reply: PRIORITY: Heavy itching for palms and soles without skin rash fit mean say liver bile dey build up (cholestasis of pregnancy). Dis need special liver blood test to protect your baby. Visit your clinic within 24 to 48 hours.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My ankle dey swell small for evening but e dey go down if I raise legs up, and my face no swell.
reply: PRIORITY: Mild ankle swelling wey dey clear when you lift legs and get no face swelling or headache na common pregnancy fluid. But make sure dem check your blood pressure and urine for your next clinic to confirm say everything safe.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: Dem tell me say I carry twins. How my antenatal clinic visits suppose dey be?
reply: PRIORITY: Twin pregnancy get higher risk for early labour and high BP. You go need more regular clinic checkup than person wey carry one baby—usually every 2 to 3 weeks for second trimester and every week from 32 weeks. Consult your doctor to set proper schedule.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I see small brown smear for tissue after vaginal examination yesterday. E dey okay?
reply: PRIORITY: Small brown stain right after doctor check your down-below dey common because neck of womb get plenty blood during pregnancy. But if the spotting turn fresh red, plenty, or pain join am, seek emergency care immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I miss my scheduled tetanus injection last month. Wetin I go do now?
reply: PRIORITY: You no need to start the injection from beginning again. Visit your primary health centre as soon as possible make dem give you the next Td dose so that you and baby go stay protected against tetanus.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I get 26 weeks belle and my fasting blood sugar result na 105 mg/dL. Wetin dis mean?
reply: PRIORITY: Fasting blood sugar of 105 mg/dL dey high. According to WHO guideline, fasting blood sugar of 92 mg/dL or higher in pregnancy mean gestational diabetes (GDM). High sugar fit make baby big pass normal and bring delivery wahala. Visit your antenatal clinic within 24 to 48 hours for checkup and food management.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I dey feel sad, dey cry constantly, and cannot bond with my pregnancy for over three weeks now.
reply: PRIORITY: Continuous sadness, heavy crying, and feeling detached during pregnancy na signs of pregnancy depression. You no dey alone, and help dey. Please talk openly with your clinic nurse at your next visit so dem fit give you proper counseling and care.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I feel sharp jabbing pain for the sides of my lower belly when I stand up fast, but no bleeding.
reply: PRIORITY: Sharp jabbing pains on lower belly sides when you move suddenly na round ligament pain, as womb dey stretch. Moving gently and resting dey help. If pain continue steadily, become severe, or blood join am, see doctor.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: Which side be best to sleep during second and third trimester?
reply: ROUTINE: Sleeping on your side—especially left side—dey recommended during late pregnancy. Dis one dey improve blood flow go placenta and baby, and dey prevent heavy womb from pressing the big vena cava blood pipe. Using pillow between your knees dey give extra support.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I fit travel by bus from Akure to Lagos at 30 weeks pregnancy?
reply: ROUTINE: Travel dey generally safe up to 36 weeks for pregnancy wey no get problem. On long road trip, drink plenty clean water, wear loose clothes, move your feet regular make blood flow, and stop small to stretch legs. Always carry your antenatal card along.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: E safe to visit dentist to clean my teeth while pregnant?
reply: ROUTINE: Yes, routine dental checkup and teeth cleaning dey safe and strongly advised during pregnancy. Pregnancy hormones fit make gums swell and bleed. Tell your dentist say you carry belle so dem go take proper care, like wearing lead apron if X-ray dey needed.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Which kind exercise dey safe for me in my second trimester?
reply: ROUTINE: Gentle exercise like brisk walking, pregnancy yoga, and Kegel pelvic exercise dey safe and beneficial. Avoid contact sports, lifting heavy load, and lying flat on back after first trimester. Drink water and stop immediately if you feel dizzy or short of breath.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I notice one dark straight line wey run down the middle of my belly. Wetin be dat?
reply: ROUTINE: That dark line na wetin dem dey call linea nigra. E dey completely normal and harmless, caused by pregnancy hormones and melanin skin pigment. E dey fade away on its own within few months after delivery without any treatment.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I dey feel rhythmic tiny jumping movements for my belly every few seconds. E normal?
reply: ROUTINE: Regular rhythmic tapping or jumping movement na almost always baby hiccups! E dey happen as baby diaphragm dey develop and e dey practice breathing movement inside fluid. E completely normal and na good sign of healthy growth.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin be the essential items wey I suppose pack inside my hospital delivery bag?
reply: ROUTINE: Essential items include your antenatal card, clean wraps/towels, maternity sanitary pads, baby clothes, warm caps, socks, baby blankets, mild soap, and the delivery pack recommended by your hospital (like cord clamp, clean gloves, chlorhexidine). Pack your bag by 34 to 36 weeks.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin be emergency birth preparedness plan and why I need one?
reply: ROUTINE: A birth preparedness plan specify the health facility you choose, steady 24/7 transport, emergency money kept aside, trusted birth companion, and blood donors if needed. Having dis plan ready dey prevent dangerous delay during unexpected emergency.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why I must take iron and folic acid every day during pregnancy?
reply: ROUTINE: Folic acid dey prevent serious birth defect for baby brain and backbone, while iron dey prevent shortage of blood for mama and support proper blood flow for you and your unborn child. Take your routine supplements as prescribed by clinic.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I fit drink palm wine or mild herbal mixtures to cleanse the baby skin?
reply: ROUTINE: No. Palm wine contains alcohol which fit cause permanent brain and body problems for baby (fetal alcohol syndrome), and herbal mixtures (agbo) get unknown chemicals wey fit spoil mama kidney and cause miscarriage. Drink clean water and eat balanced food instead.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Help! I get 36 weeks and heavy blood dey pour down my legs with serious lower belly cramps.
reply: EMERGENCY: Heavy vaginal bleeding for late pregnancy na critical emergency wey fit mean say placenta don cover womb mouth or detach. No put anything inside down-below. Rush immediately to the nearest emergency hospital maternity unit.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My vision completely blur, I get spots for my eyes, and my head dey pound like say e wan burst.
reply: EMERGENCY: Sudden heavy vision changes join with severe headache na critical red flags for impending eclampsia (pregnancy fits). You need urgent hospital evaluation and emergency BP control right now.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I never feel my baby move since yesterday afternoon. Make I wait till tomorrow morning?
reply: EMERGENCY: No wait till tomorrow at all. Absence of baby movement for pass 12 to 24 hours na medical emergency wey need immediate hospital check. Go to your delivery centre right now to check baby heartbeat.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My water burst with green thick slime water and my belle dey pain me.
reply: EMERGENCY: Greenish fluid show say baby don pass stool (meconium) inside water, which means baby dey inside serious stress. You must go to a hospital wey get newborn intensive care immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I get 34 weeks belle and I dey run 39.5 degree fever with heavy shaking and confusion.
reply: EMERGENCY: High fever with confusion and chills in pregnancy na sign of severe infection or severe malaria. This fit cause early delivery and maternal collapse. Seek emergency hospital care immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I dey get painful contractions every 4 minutes and I live 45 minutes far from the hospital.
reply: EMERGENCY: Contractions every 4 minutes mean active labour don set. Because you get 45 minutes travel time, you suppose start going to hospital immediately to make sure you deliver safely under skilled nurses and doctors.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I get 16 weeks belle and I dey feel dizzy with sharp pain on one side of my pelvic bone.
reply: EMERGENCY: Sharp one-sided pelvic pain with dizziness in pregnancy need urgent check to rule out ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy growing outside womb) or appendicitis. Go to the nearest emergency clinic right away.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I get mild dull back pain and heavy pressure inside my pelvis for the past two days at 28 weeks.
reply: PRIORITY: Continuous pelvic pressure and dull back pain before 37 weeks fit be early signs say womb neck dey open or early labour contractions. Please visit your clinic within 24 to 48 hours for proper examination.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: You fit prescribe malaria tablets for me? My body dey feel feverish.
reply: PRIORITY: MotherlyPulse cannot prescribe antimalarial drugs or give drug dosages. Fever in pregnancy need proper malaria blood test (RDT or lab test) for health centre so doctor go prescribe pregnancy-safe medicine. Visit your clinic today.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I test positive for Hepatitis B for my first antenatal booking. Wetin dem suppose do for my baby?
reply: PRIORITY: When mama get Hepatitis B, the baby must receive both Hepatitis B vaccine and Hepatitis B Immunoglobulin (HBIG) within 12 to 24 hours after birth to stop mother-to-child infection. Discuss with your delivery hospital in advance so the birth injections go dey ready.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I never shit for four days now and my stomach dey feel uncomfortable and full.
reply: PRIORITY: Constipation dey common because pregnancy hormone dey slow down digestion and iron medicine dey harden stool. Increase clean water, chop plenty vegetables and fruits, and walk. If e stay long or pain you, consult clinic before taking laxatives.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: Wetin be the recommended number of antenatal clinic visits according to WHO guidelines?
reply: ROUTINE: The World Health Organization (WHO) recommend minimum of 8 antenatal contacts throughout pregnancy: one in first trimester, two in second trimester, and five in third trimester. This regular checkup helps detect and prevent complications early.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How sleeping inside treated mosquito net dey help my pregnancy?
reply: ROUTINE: Sleeping inside Insecticide-Treated Net (ITN) every night protects pregnant women from mosquito bite wey carry malaria. Preventing malaria reduces the risk of blood shortage for mama, miscarriage, stillbirth, and small baby weight.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: When be the best time during pregnancy to do detailed baby ultrasound scan?
reply: ROUTINE: The best time for comprehensive baby scan na between 18 and 22 weeks of pregnancy. At this age, the baby organs, backbone, limbs, and placenta position can be clearly checked.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Which kind local food rich in protein and calcium I fit chop for Ondo State?
reply: ROUTINE: Very good local sources of protein and calcium include eggs, fresh and dry fish, crayfish, beans (ewa), soy milk, wara, moringa leaves, and dark green vegetables like ugwu and waterleaf. These support baby bone and body development.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I fit drink coffee or tea during pregnancy?
reply: ROUTINE: Too much caffeine fit restrict baby growth. WHO guideline recommend say make you limit caffeine to less than 200 to 300 mg per day (about 1 to 2 small cups of light coffee or tea). Also, avoid drinking tea with food because it blocks your body from absorbing iron.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why my legs dey cramp for night and how I fit stop am?
reply: ROUTINE: Night leg cramps dey common in second and third trimester, often connected to muscle tiredness or calcium balance. Gently stretching calf muscles before bed, drinking enough water, and taking walks during the day help calm cramps down.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How I go know if my labour pain na false labour or real true labour?
reply: ROUTINE: False labour contractions (Braxton Hicks) no dey come regular, dem no dey get closer together, and dem dey ease when you rest or change position. True labour pains come at regular intervals, progressively get longer, stronger, and closer, and no dey stop when you rest.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin my husband or partner suppose do to support my birth plan?
reply: ROUTINE: Your partner can help by attending antenatal clinic with you, making sure transport and money dey ready in advance, keeping maternity bag handy, giving back rubs, and speaking up for your care choices at the hospital.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I hear say wearing flat comfortable shoe dey important when pregnant. True talk?
reply: ROUTINE: Yes, wearing low-heeled supportive shoes with good grip is recommended. Pregnancy hormones relax pelvic joints, shifting your body balance and increasing the risk of falling and back pain. High heels should be avoided during pregnancy.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My 3-day-old newborn baby suddenly refuse to suck breast, body weak patapata and e hard to wake am.
reply: EMERGENCY: Inability to feed and complete weakness or floppiness for newborn pikin na critical danger sign of severe blood infection (sepsis) or metabolic collapse. Rush your baby immediately to the nearest hospital emergency or neonatal intensive care unit.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My baby chest dey suck deep inside with every breath and e dey make grunting sound.
reply: EMERGENCY: Deep chest indrawing and audible grunting sound na severe signs of acute breathing distress (like pneumonia or lung failure). Your baby need immediate emergency hospital care and oxygen. Rush go hospital right now.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My one-week-old baby umbilical cord don red, swell up, dey smell bad, and yellow pus dey commot.
reply: EMERGENCY: Severe redness, swelling, and smelly pus around cord base mean severe cord infection (omphalitis). Dis infection fit quickly enter baby blood cause sepsis. Take your baby to a hospital emergency unit immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My 4-day-old baby dey shake hand and leg repeatedly and rolling eyes back.
reply: EMERGENCY: Rhythmic jerking of hands and legs, eye-rolling, or stiff body in a newborn na convulsion (neonatal seizures). Keep baby airway clear, no put anything inside mouth, and carry baby go emergency pediatric hospital immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My baby wey dem born 2 days ago don yellow all over, even the palm of hands and bottom of feet.
reply: EMERGENCY: Yellow jaundice reaching baby palms and feet soles within first few days na severe condition wey fit cause permanent brain damage (kernicterus). Your baby need urgent serum bilirubin test and immediate light therapy (phototherapy) for hospital.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My 2-week-old baby dey feel very cold to touch and get low temperature of 35 degree even as I wrap am.
reply: EMERGENCY: Body temperature below 36.0°C (hypothermia) in newborn is dangerous and frequently signals severe infection. Place the baby skin-to-skin against your chest covered with warm blanket, and transport immediately to health facility.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I deliver 4 days ago and suddenly soaking big pad in less than 30 minutes with big blood clots.
reply: EMERGENCY: Soaking through pads within an hour or passing big blood clots after delivery na secondary postpartum hemorrhage. This need immediate emergency treatment to prevent shock. Go to hospital right away.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I do CS operation 5 days ago and the wound dey tear open with thick yellow discharge and fever.
reply: EMERGENCY: Operation wound opening up with pus and fever na severe surgical infection. This requires urgent doctor review, wound cleaning, and IV antibiotics at the hospital emergency department.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I dey get scary thoughts to harm my newborn baby and my mind dey run fast without control.
reply: EMERGENCY: Having thoughts to harm yourself or your baby na urgent psychiatric emergency wey fit happen with postpartum psychosis. Please carry baby give trusted family member and make someone take you to hospital emergency room right now.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My one-month-old baby dey vomit forcefully across room after every single feed and lips dry.
reply: EMERGENCY: Projectile vomiting after every feed with dry lips in small infant suggests stomach blockage (pyloric stenosis). This need immediate pediatric hospital evaluation and drip rehydration.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My 6-week-old baby get fever of 38.2 degree Celsius. Wetin be the paracetamol dose to give?
reply: EMERGENCY: Any fever of 38.0°C or higher in an infant younger than 3 months na critical medical emergency wey fit indicate severe infection or sepsis. MotherlyPulse cannot prescribe paracetamol dosage. Do not attempt to self-medicate; carry your baby immediately to the nearest hospital emergency room.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: Dem deliver my baby for house 3 days ago. I fit still carry am go for birth vaccines?
reply: PRIORITY: Yes! Carry your baby go the nearest Primary Health Care centre or clinic as soon as possible. Your baby fit still get the birth doses: BCG (for tuberculosis), OPV 0 (oral polio), and Hepatitis B birth dose.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My left breast dey hot, swollen, throbbing with pain, and get red line. I also get mild fever.
reply: PRIORITY: Red painful breast with fever show breast infection (mastitis). Continue breastfeeding or pump milk from that breast to free the milk, put warm cloth, and visit clinic today for antibiotic check.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My baby get white patches on tongue and inner cheeks wey dey bleed small when wiped.
reply: PRIORITY: White patches wey no dey commot easily na oral thrush (fungal infection). E dey make sucking painful for baby and fit pass to your nipples. Take baby to health centre for safe antifungal drops (like nystatin).
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My baby don shit 5 watery green stool today and body dey thirsty pass normal.
reply: PRIORITY: Watery stool fit dehydrate baby quickly. Continue frequent breastfeeding and give Low-Osmolarity ORS and Zinc tablets as health workers advise. Visit primary health clinic today.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My 2-week-old baby eyes dey sticky and bring yellow crust every morning.
reply: PRIORITY: Eye discharge in newborn can be caused by bacteria infection during birth. Gently clean eyes with clean cotton soaked in boiled cooled water from inside out. Visit clinic for antibiotic eye ointment.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My delivery stitches from 6 days ago dey feel very sore, tight, and peppery.
reply: PRIORITY: Some soreness is normal, but worsening pain, redness, or smelling discharge fit mean wound infection. Wash gently with warm water, pat dry from front to back, and let midwife check am if pain increase.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My nipples dey crack, dey bleed, and breastfeeding dey give me sharp pain whenever baby latch.
reply: PRIORITY: Cracked bleeding nipples almost always happen when baby latch only the nipple tip. Make sure baby takes big mouthful of the dark breast circle. Rub a drop of breastmilk on nipple and see nurse for latch correction.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: Body just dey tire me, I dey cry every afternoon, and e dey do me like say I be bad mother for 2 weeks now.
reply: PRIORITY: Persistent crying and feeling inadequate past two weeks point to postpartum depression, which affects many mothers and can be treated. Talk with your partner and consult clinic health worker for counseling.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My baby dem born am 2.2 kg (low birth weight). Which special care e need for house?
reply: PRIORITY: Low birth weight babies (< 2.5 kg) lose body heat fast. Practice Kangaroo Mother Care (holding baby skin-to-skin against your chest), breastfeed frequently (at least every 2 hours), and visit clinic weekly for weight check.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: Wetin be that yellow thick milk wey dey come out first 2 days, and make I throw am away?
reply: ROUTINE: That thick yellow milk na colostrum. DO NOT throw am away! Colostrum is rich in natural antibodies and protein that act as baby first vaccine, protecting stomach from infection and helping pass first stool (meconium).
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How I suppose clean and take care of my baby umbilical cord stump?
reply: ROUTINE: Apply 7.1% Chlorhexidine gel daily to the cord as recommended in Nigeria, or keep am clean and dry. Fold diaper below cord to prevent urine touch. Never put hot water, Robb, cow dung, ash, or powder, as these cause deadly infections.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My 2-month-old baby need water during hot season for Ondo State?
reply: ROUTINE: No. Breastmilk get pass 80% water and gives all the water and food your baby need, even in hot weather. Giving water carries germs, brings diarrhea, and reduces baby appetite for milk. Practice exclusive breastfeeding for 6 full months.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How often I suppose breastfeed my newborn baby inside 24 hours?
reply: ROUTINE: Breastfeed on demand whenever baby shows hunger signs (moving head, sucking hands, lip smacking). Newborns usually nurse 8 to 12 times in 24 hours (every 2 to 3 hours). Don't wait until baby cries, because crying is late hunger sign.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin be the correct way to help my baby latch onto breast without pain?
reply: ROUTINE: Hold baby tummy-to-tummy facing your breast. Touch nipple to baby upper lip to encourage wide mouth opening. Bring baby quickly to breast, aiming nipple toward roof of mouth so mouth covers more of the lower dark circle.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why my newborn baby dey spit out small milk after feeding?
reply: ROUTINE: Spitting small milk (posseting) dey very common because the valve between baby stomach and throat still dey mature. Hold your baby upright for 15 to 20 minutes after feeds and gently burp am over your shoulder to release trapped breeze.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Which vaccines baby dey receive at birth inside Nigeria?
reply: ROUTINE: Under Nigeria National Immunization Schedule, every newborn suppose get three vaccines within 24 hours of birth: BCG (for tuberculosis), Oral Polio Vaccine (OPV 0), and Hepatitis B birth dose (Hep B 0). Dem dey give am free for government health centres.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why e dey important to wait at least 24 hours before giving newborn first bath?
reply: ROUTINE: Delaying first bath for at least 24 hours dey prevent dangerous cold (hypothermia) and protect the natural white cream (vernix) on baby skin, wey act like protective antibacterial cream and skin shield.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How many wet diapers well-fed 1-week-old baby suppose produce in one day?
reply: ROUTINE: From day 5 upwards, well-fed baby suppose wet at least 6 heavy diapers per 24 hours with clear light urine, plus 3 to 4 soft yellowish stools. Dis na dependable sign say baby dey get enough breastmilk.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin be normal lochia bleeding after delivery, and how long e dey last?
reply: ROUTINE: Normal discharge after birth (lochia) dey bright red for first 3 to 4 days, turn brown-pink for next two weeks, and turn yellowish-white up to 4 to 6 weeks. E suppose dey reduce steadily without any bad smell.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How I fit relieve breast engorgement when milk rush come on day 3?
reply: ROUTINE: To ease full tight breast, feed baby frequently (every 2 hours), put warm towel or warm water shower before feeding make milk flow, and express small milk by hand to soften breast so baby fit latch easy. Cold cloth between feeds dey reduce swelling.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: When mama and baby suppose go for their routine postnatal checkup visits?
reply: ROUTINE: WHO and FMOH recommend postnatal care (PNC) visits at 24 hours after birth, on day 3 (48 to 72 hours), between days 7 to 14, and at 6 weeks postpartum. These checks check maternal healing, baby growth, cord healing, and immunization.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin be the difference between normal postpartum 'baby blues' and true postpartum depression?
reply: ROUTINE: 'Baby blues' involves small mood changes, small crying, and worry wey start around day 3 and finish on its own within 10 to 14 days with rest. Postpartum depression dey more severe, pass two weeks, and stops mama from caring for herself or her baby.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How I fit safely pump and store breastmilk if I need to return to work?
reply: ROUTINE: Wash hands clean. Fresh expressed breastmilk can stay at clean room temperature (up to 25°C) for 4 hours, in fridge for up to 4 days, or deep freezer for 6 months. Warm stored milk inside a bowl of warm water; never use microwave for breastmilk.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Which safe sleep position I suppose use for my newborn to prevent cot death?
reply: ROUTINE: Always lay your baby to sleep on their back on a firm, flat surface. Keep soft pillows, heavy blankets, and toys out of sleeping area. Keep baby in your room inside their own separate cot to lower risk of Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS).
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Breastfeeding fit act as natural family planning after delivery?
reply: ROUTINE: Yes, Lactational Amenorrhea Method (LAM) fit reach 98% effective if three conditions meet together: your monthly period never return, you dey do exclusive breastfeeding day and night without any food/water, and your baby is under 6 months old.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How I fit care for my baby red diaper rash at home?
reply: ROUTINE: Change wet or dirty diaper quickly. Wash skin gently with plain warm water and pat dry without rubbing hard. Allow skin air-dry completely for few minutes before putting fresh diaper, and apply thin layer of zinc oxide cream or petroleum jelly (vaseline).
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My baby dey cry for 2 hours every evening at the same time. E fit be colic?
reply: ROUTINE: Predictable periods of heavy crying in an otherwise healthy thriving baby is commonly infant colic. Soothe your baby with gentle rocking, skin-to-skin holding, or bicycle leg movements. Colic usually peaks around 6 weeks and disappears by 3 to 4 months.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: When I fit start to meet my husband again after natural delivery?
reply: ROUTINE: Most doctors advise waiting until delivery bleeding stops completely and any tear healing finish, usually around 4 to 6 weeks postpartum. Make sure you discuss reliable family planning method with health worker, because pregnancy fit enter before period returns.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why my newborn skin dey look dry and start peeling after the first few days?
reply: ROUTINE: Skin peeling is completely normal for newborns, especially those born at full term. In the womb, amniotic fluid protected them; as skin adapts to fresh air, the outer layer naturally sheds off. No special cream or lotion is needed.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My baby stop breathing for 20 seconds and her lips turn blue.
reply: EMERGENCY: Pause in breathing lasting 20 seconds or lips turning blue (apnea and cyanosis) na life-threatening emergency. Gently rub baby back, clear the airway, and transport immediately to emergency pediatric ward.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My 3-week-old baby get blood inside stool and belly swell up hard.
reply: EMERGENCY: Blood in infant stool with swollen hard belly is emergency sign of severe bowel infection (necrotizing enterocolitis) or blockage. Stop all feeds and rush to pediatric emergency department immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I deliver 3 days ago and get severe lower belly pain with bad smelling brown discharge and shivering.
reply: EMERGENCY: Foul-smelling lochia with womb pain and fever/shivering indicates severe womb infection (puerperal sepsis). This is a leading cause of maternal death and requires immediate hospital admission and IV antibiotics.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My baby fall from bed onto concrete floor and now unconscious.
reply: EMERGENCY: Loss of consciousness after fall indicates possible brain injury or internal head bleeding. Keep baby neck and spine straight, do not shake the baby, and go directly to emergency trauma hospital immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My 5-week-old baby soft spot on top of head dey swell bulge outside and tense.
reply: EMERGENCY: A bulging or tense fontanelle (soft spot) when baby is calm and upright indicates pressure inside the brain, often caused by meningitis. Seek emergency hospital care immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My baby dey close with person wey get active tuberculosis (TB). Wetin we suppose do?
reply: PRIORITY: Infants exposed to active TB get high risk of fast TB infection. Take your baby to the DOTS TB clinic or health centre this week for clinical check and preventive medicine (like isoniazid therapy).
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My breastfed baby never shit for 4 days but dey fart, feeding well, and tummy soft.
reply: PRIORITY: Exclusively breastfed babies older than few weeks fit go several days without stool because breastmilk leaves very small waste. If baby feeds happily, belly soft, and passing gas, e dey normal. If vomiting or hard tummy start, see doctor.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I feel one hard lump wey no dey pain me inside my breast wey refuse to go after nursing.
reply: PRIORITY: Although most breast lumps in nursing mothers are blocked milk ducts, any lump wey refuse to go must be examined by medical professional. Visit clinic this week for breast examination.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: How I suppose do tummy time with my 1-month-old baby?
reply: ROUTINE: Start with 2 to 3 sessions of tummy time per day, 3 to 5 minutes each, while baby is awake and supervised. Placing baby tummy-down on your chest or on a clean cloth helps strengthen neck, shoulder, and back muscles.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin I suppose chop while breastfeeding make my breastmilk get high quality?
reply: ROUTINE: A nursing mother needs about 500 extra calories per day and plenty fluids. Chop balanced diet with local foods: beans, fish, eggs, groundnuts, green vegetables (ugwu, bitterleaf), fruits, and clean water. Continue taking your postpartum vitamins if prescribed.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My 2-month-old baby eyes don sink inside, fontanelle dip deep, and when I pinch tummy skin e stay folded.
reply: EMERGENCY: Deeply sunken eyes, sunken soft spot, and very slow skin pinch return show severe life-threatening dehydration. Your baby needs urgent intravenous fluid drip at the nearest emergency pediatric hospital right now.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My baby get high fever, stiff neck, and dey cry heavy pain anytime I touch or move the head.
reply: EMERGENCY: High fever combined with stiff neck and serious crying pain is a major sign of acute bacterial meningitis. This requires immediate hospital admission, spinal fluid check, and IV antibiotics at emergency hospital today.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My 7-month-old baby dey make sharp whistling sound when breathing in and cannot swallow saliva.
reply: EMERGENCY: Whistling sound when breathing in (stridor) and inability to swallow saliva point to blocked upper windpipe (like severe croup or swallowed object). Keep child calm, sit upright, and rush to emergency hospital immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My baby drink kerosene by mistake from small bottle on floor and dey cough violently.
reply: EMERGENCY: DO NOT force baby to vomit and DO NOT give palm oil, milk, or water! Making baby vomit can push kerosene into the lungs, causing severe chemical pneumonia. Carry baby and the container to hospital emergency room immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I deliver 10 days ago and suddenly one leg calf swell up, turn red, and dey pain me to walk.
reply: EMERGENCY: Sudden painful swelling and redness in one calf postpartum are typical signs of Deep Vein Thrombosis (blood clot), wey fit travel to lungs. Avoid massaging the leg at all and go to emergency hospital immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My baby is 6 weeks old. Which vaccines e suppose receive at health centre this week?
reply: PRIORITY: At 6 weeks of age, your baby is due for the first multi-antigen immunization: Pentavalent 1, PCV 1, OPV 1 (polio drops), and Rotavirus 1. Carry your child's immunization card go your primary health centre this week.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My baby get small fever and crankiness for one day after getting the 6-week injection. E dey dangerous?
reply: PRIORITY: Low fever and mild crankiness within 24 to 48 hours of injection are common side effects as the body builds defense. Dress baby in light clothes, continue frequent breastfeeding, and put cool damp cloth on injection spot. If fever pass 38.5°C, visit clinic.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I fit give cough syrup to my 4-month-old baby wey get running nose?
reply: PRIORITY: Over-the-counter cough and cold syrups should NEVER be given to children under 2 years old, as they can cause severe sleepiness, breathing stoppage, and death. Clean blocked nose with normal saline drops and continue breastfeeding. Consult clinic if cough persist.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My 5-month-old baby dey pull his right ear constantly, dey cry during feeds, and water dey commot from the ear.
reply: PRIORITY: Ear pulling, crying, and ear discharge show middle ear infection (otitis media). Do not insert cotton buds or oil into the ear canal. Please take your baby to health centre this week for doctor check and proper oral antibiotics.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: We miss our baby 10-week immunization visit by pass one month. We go restart all the injections from beginning?
reply: PRIORITY: No, you never need to restart the vaccine schedule from the beginning! Your baby retains body defense from earlier doses. Visit your nearest clinic this week to get the second doses (Penta 2, PCV 2, OPV 2, Rota 2) and continue normal schedule.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: Which vaccines dem schedule for baby at 14 weeks of age in Nigeria?
reply: PRIORITY: At 14 weeks, infants receive Pentavalent 3, PCV 3, Oral Polio Vaccine 3 (OPV 3), and Inactivated Polio Vaccine (IPV 1 injection). Completing these doses gives strong protection against diphtheria, tetanus, whooping cough, hepatitis B, Hib, pneumonia, and polio.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My 4-month-old baby no dey smile back at me or turn head towards sound.
reply: PRIORITY: By 4 months, most babies dey smile back, follow objects with eyes, and react to voices. Absence of smile or no reaction to sound fit mean hearing or developmental delay. Ask for baby development check at your primary clinic.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I wan start family planning while breastfeeding my 7-week-old baby. Which options dey safe?
reply: PRIORITY: Progestin-only contraceptives (like implant under skin, DMPA injection, or progestin pills), coil (IUD), and condoms are very safe during breastfeeding because they do not reduce milk supply. Visit family planning clinic to choose the best one.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I fit give pure natural honey to my 8-month-old baby to sweeten his pap?
reply: ROUTINE: No! Never give honey to an infant under 12 months old, whether raw or cooked. Honey can carry germs that produce deadly poison in baby intestine (infant botulism), causing muscle weakness, paralysis, and breathing failure.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: When I suppose start to give my baby solid food, and which food I go start with?
reply: ROUTINE: Complementary food starts at exactly 6 months while continuing breastfeeding. Start with thick smooth enriched pap (like corn or guinea corn pap enriched with ground crayfish, soya, egg yolk, or milk) and mashed fruits like ripe banana or pawpaw.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why watery light corn pap alone no dey enough for 7-month-old baby?
reply: ROUTINE: Plain watery corn pap (ogi/koko) na mostly water and carbohydrates with very little protein, iron, zinc, or vitamins. Rapidly growing babies need food wey get heavy nutrition. Always mix pap with ground fish, crayfish, beans, egg, or milk to prevent malnutrition and stunting.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How many times a day 8-month-old breastfed baby suppose chop complementary food?
reply: ROUTINE: A breastfed baby aged 6 to 8 months should get complementary food 2 to 3 times a day, increasing to 3 to 4 times a day with 1 to 2 healthy snacks (like fruit) between 9 and 23 months, alongside frequent breastfeeding.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Which vaccines baby dey receive at 9 months of age in Nigeria?
reply: ROUTINE: At 9 months of age, your baby suppose receive the first Measles vaccine dose (Measles 1), Yellow Fever vaccine, and Meningococcal A vaccine (Men A). These protect against dangerous childhood sicknesses.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: When my baby suppose receive Vitamin A drop supplement?
reply: ROUTINE: High-dose Vitamin A capsules dey start from 6 months of age, and then repeated every 6 months until age 5. Vitamin A strengthens body defense, promotes sharp eyesight, and reduces child death from measles and diarrhea.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Which age I suppose expect my baby to sit down without support?
reply: ROUTINE: Most babies learn to sit without support between 6 and 8 months of age. Some fit sit small with hands forward around 6 months and balance properly without hand support by 7 to 8 months.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why e dey dangerous to shake crying baby violently when person dey vex?
reply: ROUTINE: Shaking an infant causes the brain to violently bounce against the head bone (Shaken Baby Syndrome), tearing delicate blood pipes and causing permanent brain damage, blindness, or death. If crying overwhelms you, put baby safely in cot and take few minutes to calm down.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How I go safely clean my baby gums and first teeth?
reply: ROUTINE: Wipe baby gums twice a day with clean soft damp washcloth. Once first tooth shows (around 6 months), use soft baby toothbrush with tiny smear of fluoride toothpaste (size of grain of rice). Never put baby to sleep with bottle of sweet milk or juice.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How long I suppose continue breastfeeding after introducing solid food?
reply: ROUTINE: The World Health Organization (WHO) recommend continuing breastfeeding alongside complementary foods up to 2 years of age or beyond. Breastmilk continues to supply critical body defense, energy, and rich nutrients.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin I suppose do if my baby get fever after teething start?
reply: ROUTINE: Teething can cause drooling, tender gums, and small fussiness, but DOES NOT cause high fever, diarrhea, or cough. If baby gets real fever (> 38°C) or runny stomach, it is from infection, not teeth. Have your baby checked at health centre.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How I fit prevent fire burns and hot water accident for my crawling baby?
reply: ROUTINE: Keep crawling babies out of kitchen while cooking, place hot pots and kettles on high surfaces away from edges, keep hot water flasks far away, and always test bath water temperature with your elbow before putting baby inside tub.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why tracking my baby growth on the Road to Health chart dey important?
reply: ROUTINE: Regular monthly weighing and plotting on Child Health Card (growth chart) allows health workers to detect poor growth or stunting early before severe malnutrition develops. Always carry the card to every immunization and clinic visit.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: When my baby suppose receive deworming medicine inside Nigeria?
reply: ROUTINE: Routine deworming (with albendazole or mebendazole) is recommended for children starting from 12 months of age, repeated every 6 months. Deworming prevents worm infections that cause blood shortage and poor physical growth.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I fit give my 7-month-old baby carton cow's milk instead of breastmilk?
reply: ROUTINE: Plain whole cow milk should not be given as main drink before 12 months of age. Too much protein and minerals inside am dey stress small baby kidney, e no get enough iron, and e fit cause stomach bleeding wey lead to severe blood shortage.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How I go recognize signs of good mental health recovery after childbirth?
reply: ROUTINE: Healthy emotional recovery involves gradually finding joy in caring for your baby, being able to sleep when baby sleeps, eating food well, expressing feelings freely with supportive relatives, and feeling confident in your mothering abilities.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin I suppose do if my baby choke while eating solid food?
reply: ROUTINE: If baby is coughing well, allow them cough to clear the throat. If baby cannot cry, cough, or breathe, place them face down along your arm with head lower than chest, deliver up to 5 back blows between shoulder blades, then turn face-up for 5 chest thrusts. Call emergency immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: My 2-week-old baby lips and tongue turn blue and she stop breathing during nursing.
reply: EMERGENCY: Central cyanosis (blue lips and tongue) with breathing stoppage is a critical neonatal emergency indicating severe oxygen deprivation, heart defect, or lung failure. Clear the airway and rush baby immediately to hospital emergency room.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My baby don shit 8 watery diarrhea and vomit 4 times today and totally unresponsive.
reply: EMERGENCY: Severe diarrhea and vomiting with unresponsiveness signify hypovolemic shock from acute fluid loss. This is life-threatening and requires immediate IV drip fluid resuscitation at an emergency hospital without any delay.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My newborn baby belly swell big and hard like drum, and e never shit first dark poop for 48 hours.
reply: EMERGENCY: Failure to pass first stool (meconium) within 48 hours with hard swollen belly indicates intestinal blockage or blocked anus. Take your baby to a specialist pediatric surgical hospital immediately.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: I deliver 1 week ago and get high fever of 39.8C, shivering, foul vaginal discharge, and extreme pelvic pain.
reply: EMERGENCY: High fever, shivering, offensive discharge, and severe pelvic pain indicate severe womb infection (puerperal sepsis). This is a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate hospital admission and IV antibiotic treatment.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My 3-month-old baby dey cough in rapid spasms, turning red, and making loud whooping sound when breathing in.
reply: EMERGENCY: Heavy coughing spasms followed by whoop sound in 3-month-old strongly indicate whooping cough (pertussis), which can cause sudden breathing stoppage. Take your baby immediately to an emergency hospital unit.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: Wetin be the recommended dose of ampicillin drops for my 1-month-old baby cough?
reply: PRIORITY: MotherlyPulse does not give antibiotic dosages or prescribe medications. Giving unprescribed antibiotics to a 1-month-old infant is unsafe and ineffective against viral infections. Bring your baby to clinic for proper chest examination.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My baby dem born am 2 weeks ago and get yellow eyes, but his stool is pale chalky white.
reply: EMERGENCY: Jaundice accompanied by pale chalky-white stools and dark urine indicates blocked bile ducts (biliary atresia). This is a critical liver condition requiring immediate specialist hospital investigation and early surgical intervention. Take your baby to a teaching or specialist hospital today for urgent testing.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: EMERGENCY.

user_message: My 6-week-old baby get severe cradle cap with thick oily scales on scalp spreading to forehead.
reply: PRIORITY: Cradle cap is harmless and common. Soften the scales by gently rubbing pure coconut oil on the scalp 15 minutes before bath, then wash with mild baby shampoo and brush with soft baby brush. If it becomes raw or oozing, visit clinic.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: My 4-month-old baby develop heat rash with tiny red bumps inside neck and groin folds in this heat.
reply: PRIORITY: Tiny red bumps in skin folds during hot weather na heat rash (miliaria). Keep baby cool, wear light single-layer cotton clothes, sponge with lukewarm water, and avoid heavy oily creams that block sweat pores. Visit clinic if pus forms.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I feel severe pain and burning when passing urine, and urine is cloudy with bad smell, 2 weeks after birth.
reply: PRIORITY: Painful burning urination and foul-smelling cloudy urine indicate a postpartum urinary tract infection. Please visit your clinic today for urine test and safe antibiotic prescription.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: PRIORITY.

user_message: I fit give gripe water to my 1-month-old baby for stomach gas?
reply: ROUTINE: Health authorities do not recommend gripe water for babies under 6 months. It disturbs exclusive breastfeeding and some preparations contain unmeasured herbs, alcohol, or excess salt. Gentle burping and light tummy massage are safer.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin be the second dose of measles vaccine and when my child suppose take am?
reply: ROUTINE: In Nigeria, the second dose of measles vaccine (Measles 2) is given at 15 months of age. The second dose is essential because about 10 to 15% of children do not get full protection from the first dose given at 9 months.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How I go know say my baby ready to start complementary solid food at 6 months?
reply: ROUTINE: Signs of readiness include: sitting with small support and good head control, no longer pushing food out with tongue, opening mouth eagerly when food is near, and reaching out for food with hands.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin I suppose do if my baby refuse to eat a new solid food I give am?
reply: ROUTINE: It is completely normal for babies to hesitate with new food taste and texture. Never force-feed. Offer a small spoonful patiently without pressure, and try again another day. It often takes 8 to 10 tries before baby accepts new food.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How many hours of sleep 3-month-old baby normally need in a day?
reply: ROUTINE: A 3-month-old infant generally sleeps between 14 and 16 hours in 24 hours, including 3 to 4 daytime naps and longer sleep at night between feeds. Sleep patterns steadily settle as the baby grows.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: E safe to cover cloth or blanket over baby stroller to block sun?
reply: ROUTINE: No. Covering a pram or stroller with a blanket traps heat like an oven, making temperature inside rise dangerously within minutes, which can cause heatstroke and cot death (SIDS). Use a clip-on sun parasol that allows fresh breeze to circulate.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: I fit drink alcohol while breastfeeding my 5-month-old baby?
reply: ROUTINE: Alcohol enters breastmilk easily at the same level as mother's blood. It disturbs infant sleep, reduces milk letdown, and can affect baby brain development. The safest choice is to avoid alcohol completely while breastfeeding.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Why my 9-month-old baby dey cry and hold me tight anytime stranger come near?
reply: ROUTINE: Stranger anxiety and separation worry are completely normal developmental milestones between 7 and 9 months. It shows that your baby has developed strong bonding with familiar caregivers and can now tell the difference between family and strangers.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: Wetin be the best way to clean baby feeding bottles and utensils if I pump milk?
reply: ROUTINE: Wash bottles, teats, and cups thoroughly with warm soapy water using a clean bottle brush. Rinse well, then submerge them inside boiling water for at least 5 minutes or use steam sterilizer. Allow them air-dry on clean towel to stop germs.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.

user_message: How Kegel exercise dey help my recovery after giving birth?
reply: ROUTINE: Kegel exercises strengthen the pelvic floor muscles stretched during pregnancy and delivery. Doing daily pelvic squeezes improves bladder control (preventing accidental urine leakage), speeds up healing, and supports internal organs.
notes: Translated to Nigerian Pidgin. Urgency prefix: ROUTINE.
